title: Live resize
scenario: A representative screen laid out by the library's panels: a vertical FlexPanel holding a title, a wrapping paragraph, a body (a two-column FormPanel of seven fields with TextField, ComboBox, NumericStepper and Checkbox editors, a Grid over a synthetic 500-row model and a read-only RichTextEditor with headings, emphasis, a list and a quote) and a wrapping row of seven Buttons and a Label. The host is resized from 800x600 to the variant's size (uhd: 3840x2160) in 30 linear steps at 96 DPI, one frame per step; the window host's off-screen, non-activating window takes a client area beyond the desktop. Reduced motion.
drawCalls: counted per step by the counting COM wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: the host is resized to 800x600; one unchanged frame

phases.name: sweep
phases.description: step k resizes the host to 800x600 plus (k + 1) / 30 of the way to the variant's size

phases.name: rest
phases.description: unchanged frames at the variant's size

videoMemory.reason: software adapter: rendering uses system memory, which privateBytes counts

memory.trackedLiveBytes: measured from the scene build onwards

timing.reason: timing comes only from performance-timing.ps1 on a hardware adapter in a quiet window (W0.2); counts and memory are recorded here

provenance.command: performance-fixtures.ps1 -Fixture FX10 -Variant uhd -Adapter Warp -FixtureHost embedded -Configuration 'Release' -Platform x64
